assets.name: king
assets.prompt: Create a production pixel-art NPC animation sprite sheet for a retro top-down RPG. Transparent background, exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, 12 complete full-body poses on a regular grid, no text, no labels, no scenery, no shadows. Front-facing slightly three-quarter view matching the reference. Same body size, costume and camera in every cell, centered with the feet on the same baseline. Every figure fits well inside its cell with generous transparent padding. Designed to compile down to 48x48 native pixels per cell: chunky carefully shaped pixel clusters, restrained palette, dark outline, readable expressive face, no gradients or antialiasing. Row1: neutral resting pose, subtle inhale, brief blink, relaxed return. Row2: anticipatory gesture, open conversational gesture, friendly held gesture, return. Row3: small anticipation, clear happy approving gesture, hold with happy expression, relaxed return. Keep the idle changes subtle and the action gestures clearly different, all feet planted. Use ONLY the elderly crowned King in bottom row second column of reference, with white beard, gold crown, blue tunic, red cape and brown boots. Ignore all other creatures. Dignified and warm; conversation is one open palm, approval is both hands slightly lifted in welcome, head nod. Crown, beard and cape remain consistent. No new objects.
